summary: THE MALLEABLE IRON REAR HUBS MAY EXHIBIT CRACKS.  ALSO, THE FRONT AXLE HUBS MAY HAVE NOT BEEN PROPERLY HEAT TREATED.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES (91 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO PASS ENDURANCE TEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS 109.  TIRES MAY DEVELOP SEPARATION BETWEEN THE CARCASS AND BELTS.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES:SIDEWALL (2,174 affected)
summary: A HOLE APPROXIMATELY .040 INCHES IN DIAMETER PROTRUDING PARTIALLY THROUGH THE MID SIDEWALL AREA OF THE TIRE.  THIS WAS CAUSED BY A DRILL BIT PROTRUDING FROM THE MOLD AT THE MOLD VENT LOCATION.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID (37,481 affected)
summary: FLOOR MAT COULD BECOME MISPOSITIONED AND INTERFERE WITH ACCELERATOR PEDAL.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:REAR SEAT (2,397 affected)
summary: SEAT BRACKETS WHICH ANCHOR REARWARD PASSENGER SEATS MAY NOT ENGAGE PROPERLY.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:OTHER PARTS (1,600 affected)
summary: PIN IN SHIFT LOCKING PAWL MAY NOT BE PROPERLY WELDED TO THE PAWL.

title: CLOUGH EQUIP. COMPANY: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER (49 affected)
summary: WELD CRACKS AND AXLE FRACTURES COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC 122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL (50 affected)
summary: SINGLE CHECK AIR SYSTEM VALVE MAY MALFUNCTION DUE TO CORROSION.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (351 affected)
summary: WIRING HARNESSES LOCATED TO THE REAR OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD CHAFE AND SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: GRUMMAN OHIO CORP.: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:OTHER PART L (22 affected)
summary: THE FLASHING MODE OF THE DECELERATION LIGHT SYSTEM IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 108.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (616 affected)
summary: IN A FRONT END COLLISION, DUAL FUEL TANKS MAY SLIDE ON THE SUPPORT BRACKETS ALLOWING THE FUEL CROSSOVER PIPE END FITTINGS TO CONTACT A PIPE SUPPORT AND PROTECTION GUARD.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STRUCTURE:BODY:TILT CAB (8/82) (680 affected)
summary: BUCKLING OF THE TILT CYLINDERS MAY OCCUR WHILE LOWERING THE VEHICLES CAB DUE TO IMPROPER USE OF THE CAB TILT SYSTEM.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (191 affected)
summary: INCORRECT FUEL FILLER NECK ATTACHMENT SCREWS WERE USED TO ATTACH THE NECK TO THE REAR QUARTER PANELS.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (6,004 affected)
summary: THE ANTI LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) PRESSURE/WARNING SWITCH MAY EXHIBIT BRAKE FLUID SEEPAGE WHICH EVENTUALLY CAN LEAD TO LOSS OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR.  ADDITIONALLY, THE HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR AND ABS ELECTRICAL RELAYS MAY HAVE BEEN EXPOSED TO WATER CONTAMINATION DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY.  THIS CONDITION CAN CAUSE LOSS OF THE HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR AND/OR LOSS OF THE ABS FUNCTION.

title: MARMON INDUSTRIES INC.: WHEELS:RIM BASE (1,448 affected)
summary: SPACERS DO NOT MEET MANUFACTURERS SPECIFICATION, MATERIAL USED .109 THICK IN PLACE OF .156 THICK MATERIAL.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE:AXLE AS (1,083 affected)
summary: THE REAR AXLE SHAFTS MAY CONTAIN BRAKE DRUM/WHEEL STUDS THAT ARE NOT CENTERED WITH THE DRUM PILOT DIAMETER.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (90 affected)
summary: FRONT BRAKE HOSE, ROUTED FROM THE BODY BRAKE TUBING TO THE FRONT AXLE CONNECTOR, MAY BE TWISTED.
